name: vera
description: Search, read, and refine evidence from local VERA archives with source citations.

interface.shortDescription: Search archives and inspect highlighted citations.
interface.longDescription: Search .vera files or libraries, cite answers in normal prose, and open highlighted PDF pages or Markdown passages in the VERA viewer.
defaultPrompt: Search my .vera library, cite the answer, and add a button to open the sources.
Show the sources with highlighted supporting passages.
Refine this archive search to find definitions and exceptions.
